scope: Retrospective controlled ablations; original results and model defaults remain unchanged

single.priority: Rescore existing aligned_raw and uniform_raw using manuscript query-target-excluded PDS, Davis-Goadrich AUPRC and cell-weighted shared-response Pearson
single.selection: Each variant uses original validation mean(L2,cosine PDS) excluding full target panel; ties by structural Spearman, specific Pearson, smaller RMSE, candidate ID; alpha grid 0.01,0.1,1; refit fit+validation. Also evaluate fixed original full12 alpha.

double.selection: Freeze original pair structure; same seen0 validation alpha grid 0.01,0.1,1 frozen across arms; no validation refit. Fixed full12-alpha sensitivity also retained.

transfer.prior_ablation: 12 leave-one-out; recompute rank512 plus diagonal remainder and source posterior variances; freeze source temperature, source effects and OT maps
transfer.fairness: Identity may reselect temperature by original source-only leave-one-context-out validation and original candidate budget; target responses are scoring-only
transfer.evaluation: Native and matched 500-control-cell shift/clipping adapter; identical controls and DE definitions. Resource-dependent CPU implementation must pass frozen-output parity before use. Any incomplete DE parity is explicitly labelled and cannot be substituted for manuscript scores.

invariants: No test-based default or hyperparameter selection
Active view weights sum to one with V active views
Full original target bank and alignment exclusion mask fixed
Do not discard targets with absent prior coverage
Validate full-model replay against frozen predictions

statistics.interval: Pointwise percentile paired cluster bootstrap conditional on frozen predictions
statistics.double_cluster: pair across fold/context; shared constituent dependence not eliminated
statistics.transfer_cluster: perturbation across fixed four contexts; macro context weights equal
statistics.multiplicity: No unadjusted confirmatory p-values; effects and pointwise intervals reported

reporting: Report improvements, negligible effects and regressions for all specified datasets and endpoints. Manuscript recommendations follow completed results.
